verdict.rationale: Foreloop orchestrates agent work on repositories, so a repo-readiness report is a fair question for this product. The evidence never documents one. The closest features are per-pull-request product reviews scored out of 5 with P0–P2 findings, and `foreloop init` installing a skill. Both are adjacent features, not an evaluation of how ready a repository is for autonomous agents.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run a readiness report that evaluates how ready my repository is for autonomous agents
